notes.title: Patch Notes v. 1.1.8307.0
notes.content:
Greetings, mercenaries.

This update releases to all platforms, PC, Mac, on Steam, Epic & GoG, but also on Xbox, Nintendo Switch and Playstation.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png

NEW ADDITION

Polish language is finally available for everyone to enjoy Gloomhaven in!


BUGFIXES
Network version is synchronized with all consoles. It should greatly smooth out crossplay. 
Fixed desyncs in combat in crossplay multiplayer between PC and Consoles during performing action while other player scrolls initiative line 
Fixed softlock in Multiplayer when client levels up mercenary and host gets rewards in Trainer in Guildmaster mode 
Fixed Mana Potion incorrect behaviour when toggling on/off 
Minor UI fixes
ADDITIONAL CHANGES

We have officially merged the Mac branch with the default branch. This means that all Mac players will now be playing the latest version on the default branch alongside all other PC players. You should not notice any changes in gameplay as a result of this merge.

In addition, we will be closing the open beta branch on Thursday, January 18th at 11:00 AM CEST. This is because we now have a newer, more stable version of Gloomhaven available. Deleting the old beta branch will help to reduce the number of potential bugs that could occur from cross-versioning.

If you would like to keep playing the older version of Gloomhaven, you can still access it by staying on or switching to the "V28009" branch.

Please note that neither the "open beta" branch nor the "V28009" branch are compatible with the current and updated "default" branch. This means that you will not be able to switch back from the "open beta" branch nor the "V28009" branch to the default branch without losing your progress.

For those still playing on the open beta branch and willing to go to the V28009 branch to keep their saves, you will have to move your save FROM: C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\FlamingFowlStudios\Gloomhaven\GloomSavesOpenBeta
TO: C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\FlamingFowlStudios\Gloomhaven\GloomSaves

To access the V28009 branch, follow these steps:

[olist]Open the Steam client.
Click on the "Library" tab.
Right-click on "Gloomhaven" and select "Properties".
Click on the "Betas" tab.
In the "Beta participation" field, select "V28009".
Click on the "Close" button.
The game will now be updated to the "V28009" branch.[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.7944.0
notes.content:
Salutations, Gloomhaveners!

This update releases to PC and Mac (on Steam & GoG) while Xbox and Playstation players also get an update whose content will be shared both on our Discord, Twitter and Facebook pages.

We tackled many of the bugs you reported to us, so once again, we are thanking you for your help!
This update is rolling out on both the main branch and the mac_open_beta one.

Switch players were already one update ahead of everyone, so this update should put you all back on the same version and solve most of the cross-play issues you have been experiencing.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png

BUGFIXES

Network version is synchronized with all consoles. It should greatly smooth out crossplay. 
Fixed bug in Multiplayer in reward distribution after Scenario 84.
Fixed max amount of players that could join the session in Multiplayer during a scenario where there was no merc in play available for them.
Developer note: The bug allowed a third player to join the session in an already started scenario where only 2 mercenaries were in play which caused a lock up until one of them leaves.
Now card abilities that allow mercenaries to set a trap allow player to Undo the ability selection.
Fixed bug with Gold pieces remaining in doorways after looting it.
Fixed bug that showed player after victory in Campaign scenario that a new perk was available when it wasn’t.
Minor UI fixes.
Triangles: [spoiler] Malleable Evocation - fixed work of Air consumption. [/spoiler]
Cthulhu: [spoiler] when using the Grim Bargain top ability, now selection of enemies is shown on Confirm Targets. [/spoiler]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png

ADDITIONAL INFO


Polish language will be added in the next update!
If any XBS happen to be here, just a quick heads-up: on XBS, there's this occasional bug leading to random crashes (noticed recently). It seems to be an infrequent initialization glitch. If you face it, here is a quick fix: disconnect, restart the console, and relaunch the game.

Until next time, mercenaries!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE & NEW FEATURES
notes.content:
Our warmest welcome, fellow mercenaries!

We are gathered here today to celebrate the new PC update, containing new features, many bug fixes and quality of life improvements.
You can find more details below.

Also... the four new Jaws of the Lion mercenary skins are available on PC for free, right now, here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584170/Gloomhaven__Jaws_of_the_Lion_Alternative_Skins/


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png

New Features

With the consoles release, this patch adds crossplay functionality for all players. To enable it, find the Crossplay option in Options -> General and turn it ON.
Voice chat is added to the game. It can be activated when the session is hosted.
Updated game engine version as the old one could cause random crashes in Mercenary panel and during scenario.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png
UI improvements & quality of life

The gamepad option has been updated to fit with the console one.
Updated visuals in Scenario HUD for initiative panel and card deck portraits.
Inactive action buttons are now hidden instead of going in unclickable states.
Added new identifications of control in Multiplayer mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png
Scenario Fixes
Guildmaster

Déjà vu: Fixed unstable crash when starting mission.
Unlikely Alliance: fixed bug when sometimes mission didn’t finish after 10th round.
Night of the Living Sewage: fixed bug when sometimes Deep Terror wasn’t visible to players after spawn.
The Rumbling Deep: fixed bug when lava tile wasn’t properly placed on the battlefield.
Face your Demons: fixed bug when mission didn’t fail after Summoner is exhausted.
Campaign

Ancient Cistern: Fixed bug when sometimes there was no ability to cleanse the pump.
Vault Of Secrets: Fixed bug when Defeat screen appeared without failing any objectives during summoned creatures’ turn.
Infernal Throne: Fixed error “An error occurred within one of the Rule Libraries”.
Harrower Hive: Fixed error that made impossible the discard of cards at the beginning of the scenario. 
Burning Mountain: fixed error in scenario that caused game to crash. 
Windswept Highlands: fixed rare softlock when Beast Tyrant was present in the scenario 
Scorched Summit: fixed softlock when mercenary exhausted on chest tile. 
Armory Heist: fixed Rikharn portrait in character info. 
Payment Due: fixed softlock when one merc picked up the chest and other one went through a trap in the same round. 
Plagued Crypt: fixed Spirit of Xorn portrait in character info. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png

General Fixes

Fixed issue when sometimes you couldn’t enter the save after activating Solo Scenarios DLC. 
Fixed issue on gamepad control when cinematic sound continued to play if was skipped too fast. 
Fixed bug which could cause multiple action abilities (like Scoundrel’s “Quick Hands”) to be used infinite amount of times. 
Fixed game sometimes being locked when re-entering the Merchant in Guildmaster when there is a mercenary in the squad ready to level up . 
Fixed wrong implementation of Perks after going there from the Enchantment screen. 
Fixed bug which caused inability to enhance card after selling enhance from fully enchanted card. 
Fixed ‘Comparing player stats…’ in multiplayer sessions at scenario starts. 
Fixed item binding troubles in Guildmaster. 
Fixed game crash during mercenary selection in Guildmaster Multiplayer session when two players chose same merc.

notes.title: Some news about the console port and PC version!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Let me introduce myself to you all!

I'm Mike, Tech Lead at Saber, and one of the many people currently working on Gloomhaven.

I have been playing both the board game & digital version of Gloomhaven for quite a while as many others here do and it's an honor and a pleasure to be able to work on it now! 

I have been working in the industry for 11 years but this game really is something else! 

We are currently working on many elements around the game.  
Here is a snippet of what's going on :

We are polishing the console versions, which will release later this year, as you already know
Our team is focusing on optimization for PC as well - improvements such as less loading times, less memory usage, better performance especially on low-end specs
Working on a reworked UI/UX for the gamepad too! Gloomhaven is quite a complex game so the gamepad adaptation can be a real challenge.
A lot of bug fixing, the full patch notes will of course be shared with you when we release the update, but our goal is to make the game even smoother! 
We're aware we haven't communicated much as Gloomhaven requires a lot of attention and work. 
It always take some time to work on someone's else code, even more when we are expanding it for cross-platform play. 

We hope to deliver everything at the same time as the console release but some things might take a bit longer. 

At any rate, everything should be live before the end of 2023! 
We're very excited to share all of this with you.

Thank you for your patience, your support and your love for the game!

Mike

You will quickly discern that this DLC will be a considerably harder experience than you know of.
If you haven't already, you'll have to git gud.

17 new amazingly brutal scenarios, each built to challenge Mercenaries from the campaign.Every mercenary will have a specific mission they will need to complete on their own.The unique mission to each mercenary will explore their specific backstory and narrative.17 new items, each usable by only one specific Mercenary.

When a mercenary reaches Level 5, they are able to undertake their own Solo mission.
Alternatively, you can gain access to the DLC unique rewards in the Guildmaster Mode when completing the 2nd Story mission for each mercenary.
You only gain access to the items if you complete the missions, these items cannot be sold or bought by other characters. 
The mercenary has to attempt the missions on their own and if they are successful, they are awarded their specific Solo item. This item cannot be sold or bought by other characters, and any later mercenaries of the same class must also complete this mission to unlock it.
You can play these missions online in a Multiplayer game, but your co-op companions will be in spectator mode, watching you hopelessly try to survive.
You can also play these missions offline. Then, to import the fruit of your hard labor to any game, it will be automatic if you’re the host, and if you are not the host and join a game, the host has the option to import any Gold, XP and Item you gained in the Solo Scenarios.
Note - DLC enabled save games cannot be reverted to non-DLC games.

Each of the 17 mercenaries of the base game have access to their own tailored scenario.
This does not apply to the Jaws of the Lion DLC mercenaries.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

How long is the DLC going to be at launch? 
You can expect about 20+ hours to finish the 17 new missions.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

The Solo Scenarios: Mercenary Challenges DLC for Gloomhaven will cost 4.99$ / 4.99€. Get 10% off this new DLC until September 29.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Can we expect further updates / DLCs after that? 
Although we cannot share anything at this point, we will keep supporting the game after the release of the Solo Scenarios: Mercenary Challenges DLC.

How many languages will be supported on this DLC? 
All the languages of the base game will be supported: English, German, French and Spanish.

On which platforms will this DLC be released? 
The DLC will be available on Steam and GoG for Windows & MacOS.

You and your group are sitting down for some cold brew in the Sleeping Lion after a hard day's mercenary work. Protecting that merchant was too troublesome... Suddenly a peculiar Orchid covered in an innumerable amount of crystals approaches and sits down at the table.

Looking from under her shadowed hood, she begins speaking.
"So you're the the mercenary group I've heard about?"
She looks around the table.
"Not that it says much coming from the people I heard it from. But I'd like to know what kind of feats you can muster."
She eyes each of you intently, measuring your value to her.
"Prove your true worth." She snaps "Accept the challenge that is coming and uncover all that lies beneath the veil..."

A chill runs down your spine at her final words, but before you can consider responding to the ludicrous comments of this crazed Orchid, she disappears in an instant. Your group stares quietly at one another, wondering what kind of wild and harrowing adventure awaits you all...

 FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS 


Is the DLC a standalone campaign? 

No, you are able to integrate the content of the DLC (4 mercenaries, 10 items and 25 new scenarios) with a simple click of a button into an existing Story campaign without having to start over. Alternatively, all new Story campaigns will have all new mercenaries and scenarios available from the start, while the Guildmaster campaigns will only include the new mecenaries and items.
Note: DLC-enabled save games cannot be reverted to non-DLC games. 
If you play in the Guildmaster mode, once converting the save or starting a new game the 4 mercenaries will be immediately available and the items will be added to various treasure tables. 

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Why is JOTL not a standalone like the board game?

Having Jaws of the Lion as a DLC allowed us to mix and match the content of Gloomhaven and Jaws of the Lion. We needed to change some things in Jaws of the Lion for that to happen smoothly. It also allowed us to mix some of the content of the DLC with the Guildmaster mode!

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

How long is the DLC?

You can expect about 30+ hours of entirely new content.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

How many players can play together online? 

You will be able to play online up to 4 players, the same as the base game. Once a saved game is converted to be DLC compatible, all players will require the DLC to be able to join.
When starting a new campaign you will have the option to activate Jaws of the Lion or play with the base game only.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Can we expect further updates / DLCs after that?

Although we cannot share anything at this point, we will keep supporting the game after the release of Jaws of the Lion.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

How many languages are supported on Jaws of the Lion?

All the languages of the base game will be supported.
These languages are English, French, German and Spanish.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
 
On which platforms is Jaws of the Lion released?

The DLC will be available on Steam and GoG for Windows & MacOS. 

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

What about bugs?

Gloomhaven is a colossal game and Jaws of the Lion is adding thousands of mercenary combinations, possible abilities, items, perks, enhancements and enemies. While we have invested a massive amount of time and effort on making sure Jaws is ready and of the highest quality, you may still encounter issues here and there.

If you experience any bugs or issues that break the game or hinder you from progressing in the game, please report them on our support portal. 
The devs would really appreciate it if you attach a video or a screenshot of the issue and all of the information you have available. That will help us a lot in our investigation!

notes.title: Dev Blog #2
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow mercenaries!

Now is the time for you to meet the remaining two mercenaries from the upcoming Jaws of the Lion DLC: Voidwarden and Demolitionist.

As a reminder:

Each of these characters brings something new to combat within Gloomhaven Digital, including their own unique powerful ability when they reach level 5 so be prepared for spoilers about their gameplay and stop reading now if you want it to be a surprise! 

[Note: some parts of this article are hidden under black lines to avoid spoilers - Hover over them if you wish to reveal the content!]

The important thing to know is that these characters are available to use in your core Gloomhaven scenarios and core mercs can take part in Jaws scenarios, neither are limited to their own content, so the amount of combos has increased massively.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/24fc63ab7c7b87272da80ac898fe3fc363f7ff4f.png
Control Freak

The Voidwarden has access to a wide range of abilities, suited to almost any occasion, as long as that occasion involves an assortment of fangs, claws and various rusty weapons pointed in your direction. She excels however at control, both via classic crowd control abilities, debuffing multiple enemies or by directly controlling ally or enemy actions. The sheer range of options for her top and bottom half abilities can be intimidating at first.

Also, due to her ability to buff her allies (often with minor drawbacks) she performs better in larger parties where there are more mercs to aid and more enemies to exterminate.
[spoiler]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/2a4de4c7ac2c7af442f74da4c3c336ddc1d2b833.png
[/spoiler]
Call the Burn Ward
[spoiler]The Voidwarden’s Level 5 ability allows them to summon a Ward, a defensive obstacle that both poisons nearby enemies and protects the Voidwarden with a defensive disadvantage shield. As the Ward cannot be moved once placed, you’ll need to think ahead to ensure she can stay close throughout the scenario to continue to gain its effects. 
[/spoiler]
With friends like these

When playing as the Voidwarden you need to ensure your allies actually ‘want’ the bonuses you are giving them. Unlike other support classes, the Voidwarden’s buffs often come with a  drawback and that has the possibility of really hampering your friends’ plans. Then again, maybe they shouldn’t have looted ‘your’ chest? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/f4b16235623a77f2feebfcc2f0ed3457175dd75f.png

Now who have we left until last? The Tinkerer with jet boots and massive punchy gloves and a pink bandana.. Also, why haven’t I dived straight into their abilities I hear you ask, well, if you are a Gloomhaven old salt, you might be ready to say ‘Oh that Demolitionist, it works in Jaws, but if you take them into the core Gloomhaven missions the levels aren’t set up right for their abilities.’

Well, Isaac heard you, and Isaac’s design team heard Isaac, and we heard Isaac’s design team, so for Gloomhaven Digital, the Demolitionist has had a bunch of redesigns and therefore, we’ll start with the rebalance and then move onto the play style…

Firstly a number of cards have had terminology changes, but that is across the board for Jaws, mainly ‘Objectives’ changing to ‘Obstacles with hit points’ so that a number of their abilities work in the core Gloomhaven experience.

The other more major changes are as follows:

Implode Bottom - The rework here gives the ability more uses, similar to a powered up version of a couple of the Cragheart’s abilities.

Rubble Top - This was the only card that used Destruction tokens which Isaac decided to remove from the Demolitionist’s gameplay, so this ability is changed to be a powerful attack.

Rubble Bottom - Rebalanced after the changes to Destruction tokens and pushing the Demolitionist’s Dungeon altering abilities.

Nowhere to Run Bottom - Another ability doubling down on Obstacle movement.

[spoiler]Mech Suit Top - You still get a mech, but instead of a simple heal (Not great if poisoned!), you get a free rest.

Mech Suit Bottom - The Loot has been upgraded to a small attack plus obstacle creation.[/spoiler]

So, how does this make the Demolitionist play?
[spoiler]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/ab8414f4450928a1a68dbabc59c33a03dc6e1705.png
[/spoiler]
I can move any Mountain

The Demolitionist now has their obstacle movement and creation ability turned up to 11. Obstacles can be utilized to funnel enemies into your allies’ path, or reroute them through traps. Whereas in the past the player had to juggle Demolition tokens, they have more options and keep access to the Demolitionists better cards. Just remember you can’t actually drop a rock on someone’s head, leave that to ol’ Craggie.

Mechwarrior
[spoiler]The Demolitionist’s Level 5 ability gives them a decent health upgrade but more importantly refreshes ALL their discarded cards. This is now a key gameplay component, the moment to drop the mech will be extremely important although a slightly easier decision than Crystal face’s Reviving Ether.
Of course, the Demolitionist stomping about in a Mech also looks pretty cool!
[/spoiler]
Punch Out!

Aside from throwing rocks around and piloting a big robot, the Demolitionist is a melee damage dealer at heart, loving to get in close, smashing an enemy in the face and them pushing them away or backing off. They are best used protecting the squishier members of the team from danger.

The Demolitionist also have a pretty unique set of Perks, allowing them to remove a lot of Perks from their deck to get to their juicier hits more often, making every punch hit that little bit harder.

Perks

How convenient… I talk about Perks, and then look, a Perks section… Many fans of Jaws also have remarked in the past that a couple of the mercs are missing classic Gloomhaven Perks and this affects them badly in the full Gloomhaven campaign.

Well, again Isaac has been thinking of you, so there are some minor Perk tweaks as well in Jaws Digital:

The Demolitionist & Voidwarden get an ‘Ignore scenario effects’ perk and the Red Guard gets a perk that unlocks ‘Ignore Negative Item Effects’ to have access to the swanky armor sets. 

There are a few other minor tweaks to go along with these, but you’ll be able to check them out on the Perks screen in game.

The Hatchet declared themselves ‘perfect’ and sat in the corner sharpening their axes, so it was decided to leave them be. 

In Conclusion

That’s it for now, why not post a thought on which mercs you want to try out first, or come to our Discord server and discuss strategies or find other players to take Jaws on with?

You can always follow updates, share content and memes with us on our Twitter or Facebook page, and check our awesome visual content on our brand new Instagram!

See you on May 17 for the Jaws of the Lion release, adventurers!

notes.title: Dev Blog #1
notes.content:
Hail Adventurers!

The time has come to introduce you to the shady individuals available to hire as part of your mercenary troupe in Jaws of The Lion.

Each of these characters brings something new to combat within Gloomhaven Digital, including their own unique powerful ability when they reach level 5 so be prepared for spoilers about their gameplay and stop reading now if you want it to be a surprise! 

[Note: some parts of this article are hidden under black lines to avoid spoilers - Hover over them if you wish to reveal the content!]

The important thing to know is that these characters are available to use in your core Gloomhaven scenarios and core mercs can take part in Jaws scenarios, neither are limited to their own content, so the amount of combos has increased massively.

For example, base Gloomhaven Digital has a total of 2380 mercenary combinations for a group of 4 characters, with the extra four Jaws mercs added unlocked, the number of combinations almost triples with 5985! 

(Just be glad you aren’t the ones who have to ensure every single possible combination of abilities works!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/65cfe34db229a1ac36e17ff1716ee84f0350e7d6.png

Get to the Chopper!
The Inox Hatchet comes fully loaded with an infinite array of deadly Axes, but like any other good craftsman, they have their Favorite. In this case it is represented by an ability that adds a reusable +3 modifier when used on your enemies. 
Be aware though, that as an axe, it tends to get stuck in vital organs, demonic viscera and other people’s faces. Therefore an important thing to remember is that after you use the Favorite, you’ll have to go pick it up when the enemy is dead. Be careful not to spend turns retracing your steps while the rest of your party gets murdered in the next room!
[spoiler] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/29351accee3fbe7034bd5f0596d55c408be227cd.png[/spoiler]


A Breath of Fresh Air
The Hatchet’s abilities generally enjoy a fresh breeze, so pairing them with Cthulhu or a character with access to infuse or consume any brand of element will unlock their more powerful effects.

[spoiler]At Level 5, the Hatchet gets access to an even better weapon that adds Wound and Push to the ranged attacks of your choice - unfortunately, they didn’t come up with a particularly imaginative name for the new axe. [/spoiler]


When Push comes to Shove
Even though the Hatchet is primarily a range damage dealer, they share the Brute’s penchant for shoving enemies around dungeons. This makes them a great choice for those dungeons full of traps and hazardous terrain. Of course, you can always bring along someone to make some traps for you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/062a78d2b721cd714e6d2f402060a3d2b6a23c81.png

Get Over Here!

The Valrath Red Guard has a decent selection of both melee and ranged attacks, but where they excel is targeting and damaging adjacent enemies with fire or just hitting them with a thing on a chain! 
Flame Shroud is an early powerhouse and works somewhat like a simplified Retaliate, although the enemy only needs to become adjacent to trigger it. 
Combine that with a wide array of abilities which Pull hapless adversaries towards you and follow up with radial attacks and damage and the Red Guard can hold the front line - especially against Shielded enemies.
[spoiler]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/acc0ff5972b07aa5a0b28dd18c47ed06bc496a16.png
[/spoiler]
The Luck of the Devil
[spoiler] At Level 5, the Red Guard has access to the Sand Devil ability. Similar to a Summon, the Sand Devil allows the Red Guard to move enemies around the dungeon, triggering Muddle and dealing damage as they go. Combine this with their adjacent enemy targeting abilities and you’ll see the Red Guard is a master of positional combat.
Be aware, the Sand Devil can also move allies to give them an extra speed boost, just make sure to ask first, many people don’t enjoy the damage and muddling that comes with a free ride! [/spoiler]

Flame War
The Red Guard uses both Light and Flame elements and therefore combos well with Sun and certain Spellweaver builds. You’ll always need to balance both using the Elements but also setting up infusions to be used the next turn, the Red Guard without access to their consumes isn’t quite as effective.


In Conclusion

That’s it for today! We will see you next time with a blogpost about the 2 remaining mercenaries of Jaws of the Lion: Voidwarden and Demolitionist.
Make sure to check it out since we will be explaining key differences between the physical and digital format of the game!
Until then, why not tell us which merc you're most excited to try, or come to our Discord server and discuss strategies or find other players to take Jaws on with?

You can always follow updates, share content and memes with us on our Twitter or Facebook page, and check our awesome visual content on our brand new Instagram!

Till next time, mercenaries.

Is the DLC going to be a standalone campaign? 

No, you are able to integrate the content of the DLC (4 mercenaries, 10 items and 25 new scenarios) with a simple click of a button into an existing Story campaign without having to start over. If you play in the Guildmaster mode, once converting the save or starting a new game the 4 mercenaries will be immediately available and the items will be added to various treasure tables. 

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

How long is the game going to be at launch?

You can expect about 30+ hours to finish the main campaign.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

How many players can play together online? 

You will be able to play online up to 4 players, the same as the base game. Once a saved game is converted to be DLC compatible, all players will require the DLC to be able to join.
When starting a new campaign you will have the option to activate Jaws of the Lion or play with the base game only.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Can we expect further updates / DLCs after that?

Although we cannot share anything at this point, we will keep supporting the game after the release of Jaws of the Lion.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

How many languages will be supported on Jaws of the Lion?

All the languages of the base game will be supported.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
 
On which platforms will Jaws of the Lion be released?

The DLC will be available on Steam and GoG for Windows & MacOS.

Is the DLC going to be a standalone campaign? 
No, you are able to integrate the content of the DLC (4 mercenaries, 10 items and 25 new scenarios) with a simple click of a button into an existing Story campaign without having to start over. Alternatively, all new Story campaigns will have all new mercenaries available from the start and the new scenario content available after core mission 2. 

Note - DLC enabled save games cannot be reverted to non-DLC games. 

If you play in the Guildmaster mode, once converting the save or starting a new game the 4 mercenaries will be immediately available and the items will be added to various treasure tables. 

How long is the game going to be at launch?
You can expect about 30+ hours to finish the main campaign.

How many players can play together online? 
You will be able to play online up to 4 players, the same as the base game. Once a saved game is converted to be DLC compatible, all players will require the DLC to be able to join.
When starting a new campaign you will have the option to activate Jaws of the Lion or play with the base game only.

Can we expect further updates / DLCs after that?
Although we cannot share anything at this point, we will keep supporting the game after the release of Jaws of the Lion.

How many languages will be supported on Jaws of the Lion?
All the languages of the base game will be supported.
 
On which platforms will Jaws of the Lion be released?
The DLC will be available on Steam and GoG for Windows & MacOS.

notes.title: Gloomhaven 1.0 available now
notes.content:
A band of battle-scarred mercenaries violently opens the door of the Sleeping Lion. Not the best tavern in town but not so shabby as to deter bounty hunters, ruffians and other unsavoury folks. Once seated, a beer in each hand, their leader clamors with a distinctive deep voice:
“We’re back lads! Do you smell this? The scent of opportunity! We’ve left the city for two years, we’ve become Guildmasters and taken our fair share of loot, but Gloomhaven has called us home.”

With a quick glance, he notices several people whispering and counting their gold whilst looking around: 
“It seems like work is back on the menu.”

Soon enough, a heteroclite group of small-time adventurers approaches him, seemingly confused:
“Well, well, what do we have here? Green blood! Whaddaya want? A contract? An advice? A hug mayhap?”

Without giving them a chance to answer, the veteran mercenary grabs one of them by the collar and mumbles:
“No hug for you, but let me give you a piece of advice, if you’re looking for mercenary work, we’ve heard there’s a Valrath looking for hired blades capable of tracking down some stolen documents. Go see her if it is in your line of work. Now get lost!”

GLOOMHAVEN 1.0 RELEASED

[previewyoutube=8tQCpXixolE;full]https://youtu.be/8tQCpXixolE[/previewyoutube]

Esteemed mercenaries and guildmasters, will everyone please gather round?
Gloomhaven is finally 100% content complete and ready to be enjoyed by everyone out there. You will be able to play the entire board game campaign as well as the guildmaster one.
Here is what you can expect from Gloomhaven 1.0:

 The complete board game campaign (see more details below)
 A digital exclusive: the Guildmaster adventure (see more details below)
 17 unique characters, each coming with their own skills
 Thousands of abilities, perks, items and enhancements
 Dark and challenging environments filled with dangerous enemies of all sorts
 A fully voiced board game campaign by Alec Newman
 Many improvements requested by the community over the 2 years of Early Access
 Less bugs, more stability, better performance
 All of the content is fully playable in online co-op up to four players 

And, Gloomhavenologists?
We wouldn't have made it this far, nor anywhere, without you, our community.
You’ve been supporting Gloomhaven in your own ways - whether buying the game on Steam, leaving us reviews, giving feedback and reporting bugs to help us improve the game, participating in building the community on Discord, Facebook or Twitter, or simply talking about Gloomhaven to your friends.
To think that our Discord server has now grown to more than 21,000 members and we just passed 4,500 Steam reviews, I mean, what a journey. Thank you.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png

EXPERIENCE THE BOARD GAME CAMPAIGN

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/fbd0bc33dee4aa763243ff6c8bd2c0030dee2a33.png

Coming from Gloomhaven the Board Game, Isaac Childres’ ultimate strategic board game and highest rated game of all time on Board Game Geek, this branching campaign of 95 story missions will pit your greed against your morality. Numerous powers are vying for control over the city of Gloomhaven while others are looking for ancient crypts and forgotten artefacts. You could always side with the inhabitants… but it may not pay well.

A DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE: GUILDMASTER ADVENTURE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/91057d87a2b2daceca5857aad7051885a407420b.png

Created in cooperation with the community, the Guildmaster adventure offers over 160 digital exclusive missions to experience another facet of Gloomhaven. Lead your guild of mercenaries in a region overrun by far worse than simple bandits.
Choose the best combination of mercenaries for each fight and follow their character stories in dangerous new territories.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/52adf23795a53c4e91f26e340d514eca5cc5bf3e.png


FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
LAUNCH DAY EDITION

How different is Gloomhaven Digital from the original board game?

A 1:1 adaptation was both not possible or desirable, as digital platforms and their gameplay have their own advantages and drawbacks compared to tabletop. Keep in mind that differences remain very minor and Gloomhaven Digital is a very faithful adaptation of the original gameplay and design.
Every difference implemented in Gloomhaven Digital was closely discussed and custom-tailored together with the original board game author, Isaac Childres, to ensure we stayed true to Gloomhaven's core design.

_______________________

Do I need to buy the game again if I already bought the Early Access version?

No, of course not. If you already own Gloomhaven Digital, you will simply be prompted to download an update which will upgrade your Early Access version to the full 1.0 version. 

_______________________

How long is the game?

It varies a lot depending on how you play. There are 250+ missions in the game, shared between the Guildmaster and Campaign modes.
That should be at least 150 hours of gameplay if you are super fast and never lose, probably above 200+ hours for most people.

_______________________

Are my Early Access saves compatible with the 1.0 version?

Guildmaster saves will for sure be compatible, however, for Campaign Beta saves, we cannot make any promises right now, it might depend on when they have been created.

_______________________

Should I start a fresh run?

Yes, we strongly suggest you start a fresh run as the Campaign is brand new.
It is also always a possibility to start a new one on the Guildmaster mode, but not necessary, as all saves (old and new) will have the same content.

_______________________

How many players can play together online?

All of the content Gloomhaven has to offer (both the Guildmaster mode and the Campaign) is available for up to 4 players in co-op.

_______________________

Can we expect further updates after that?

Yes, we will be patching and supporting the game after launch.
DLCs are also a possibility, but our main focus is supporting the base game and making sure it matches the players’ expectations.
Anyway, we’re not going to suddenly vanish.

_______________________

Do you plan on supporting additional languages?

Our four languages at launch are English, French, German and Spanish. 
We can't promise anything else for now!

_______________________

Will you release Gloomhaven on other platforms?

It will be available at launch on Steam and GoG, and supported on PC.
Our main focus for now is to make sure the game is absolutely the best it can be on these platforms before turning to anything else.

_______________________

What about Gloomhaven on MacOS?

Initially, we wanted to release the MacOS version at launch, given that it would be stable and of a quality level we deemed appropriate for MacOS players.
As of right now, we haven’t met the standards we set for the MacOS version to be released, and thus we will keep on improving it until it can be released in a patch in the upcoming weeks.
Please believe this is one of our top priorities and we absolutely care about giving MacOS players the opportunity to join us on Gloomhaven.

_______________________

What about bugs?

Gloomhaven is a colossal game with tens of thousands of possible abilities, items, perks, enhancements, enemies and overall combinations. While we have invested a massive amount of time and effort on fixing desynchronization issues and other bugs over the past year, you may still encounter issues in the multiplayer version of Gloomhaven.

If you experience crashes or freezes, or find any additional issues that break the game or hinder you from progressing in the game, please report them on our support portal. 
The devs would really appreciate it if you attach a video or a screenshot of the issue and all of the information you have available. That will help us a lot in our investigation!

You can find the support portal here:
https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/75-gloomhaven/

You can contact us directly here:
https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/75-gloomhaven/contact-us/

Long time no see mates. I reckon we're all here?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/17ea393728dd54b9a628e6e58512f0cdd28fb41f.jpg


GLOOMHAVEN IS GRADUATING FROM EARLY ACCESS

Lo and behold, fellow guildmasters!

On October 20th, after a little more than 2 years in Early Access, Gloomhaven will finally launch its 1.0 version with all the promises made during its development! 
What a ride it has been, from Flaming Fowl and Asmodee Digital teaming up to bring to life Isaac Childres’ masterpiece of a board game, to our Early Access launch in Summer 2019, through 12 major updates and countless patches & improvements… all of this leading to Gloomhaven’s full release in Fall 2021! 

And we wouldn't have made it this far, nor anywhere, without you, our community, supporting Gloomhaven in your own ways - whether buying the game on Steam, leaving us reviews, giving feedback and reporting bugs to help us improve the game, participating in building the community on Discord, Facebook or Twitter, or simply talking about Gloomhaven to your friends! 
To think that our Discord server now has grown to more than 20,500 members. And we just passed 4,300 Steam reviews, I mean, what a journey.

DISCOVER THE GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW TRAILER

Unsheathe your sword, prepare your gear and… wait, wait, no. For once, just sit down and witness as the Gameplay Overview Trailer unfolds before your eyes, Guildmasters.

#ReleaseTheGloom

[previewyoutube=-SGDEP-zFHo;full][/previewyoutube]

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS -
LAUNCH EDITION

How different is Gloomhaven Digital from the original board game?

A 1:1 adaptation was both not possible or desirable, as digital platforms and their gameplay have their own advantages and drawbacks compared to tabletop. Keep in mind that differences remain very minor and Gloomhaven Digital is a very faithful adaptation of the original gameplay and design.
Every difference implemented in Gloomhaven Digital was closely discussed and custom-tailored together with the original board game author, Isaac Childres, to ensure we stayed true to Gloomhaven's core design.

_______________________

Will I need to buy the game again if I already bought the Early Access version?

No, of course not. If you already own Gloomhaven Digital, it won't brutally disappear from your library at launch - you will simply be prompted to download an update which will upgrade your Early Access version to the full 1.0 version. 

_______________________

How long is the game going to be at launch?

It varies a lot depending on how you play. There are 250+ missions in the game, shared between the Guildmaster and Campaign modes.
That should be at least 150 hours of gameplay if you are super fast and never lose, probably above 200+ hours for most people.

_______________________

Will my Early Access saves be compatible with the 1.0 version?

Guildmaster saves will for sure be compatible, however, for Campaign Beta saves, we cannot make any promises right now, it might depend on when they have been created.

_______________________

Should I start a fresh run at launch?

Yes, we strongly suggest you start a fresh run as the Campaign will be brand new.
It is also always a possibility to start a new one on the Guildmaster mode, but not necessary, as all saves (old and new) will have the same content.

_______________________

How content complete be the game at launch?

Gloomhaven Digital will be fully complete at launch! 

_______________________

How many players can play together online?

All of the content Gloomhaven has to offer (both the Guildmaster mode and the Campaign) will be available for up to 4 players in co-op.

_______________________

Can we expect further updates after that?

Yes, we will be patching and supporting the game after launch.
DLCs are also a possibility, but our main focus is supporting the base game and making sure it matches the players’ expectations.
Anyway, we’re not going to suddenly vanish.

_______________________

Do you plan on supporting additional languages?

Our four languages at launch will be English, French, German and Spanish. 
We can't promise anything else for now!

_______________________

Will you release Gloomhaven on other platforms?

It will be available at launch on Steam, GoG and supported both on PC and MacOS.
Our main focus for now is to make sure the game is absolutely the best it can be on these platforms before turning to anything else.

_______________________

What will be the price of the game at launch? Why is it more expensive than the Early Access? 

Since the launch of Gloomhaven's Early Access, we have clearly communicated about the price increase planned for the full release. With all the content added throughout the Early Access, including the digital exclusive Guildmaster mode, online co-op mode and eventually the acclaimed original board game campaign, Gloomhaven digital's value has substantially increased. This is why we will be increasing the price of the base game from 24,99€/$ to 34,99€/$ upon release.

Humans are by far the most dominant of the races. Their society is one of rules and regulations, but also one of great diversity. As you're wondering about the proper nomenclature, the man starts screaming as he witnesses his flesh turning green then black, whilst his companions are drawing their weapons, unsure about what's happening.

GATHER AROUND TO WELCOME THE NEWCOMERS!

Your steps have led you to the gates of the city. You have just heard the news: two newcomers are looking to join the fight. Will you succeed in recruiting them for your own guild?

Esteemed guildmasters, let me introduce you to the (Squid Face) [spoiler]Plagueherald.
Harrower Plagueheralds are a small sect of Harrowers who are one of the main reasons the entire species is in disrepute among polite Gloomhaven society.
Either misguided or ignorant of other races’ physiology, Plague Heralds believe that the spread of disease throughout a society will strengthen it and propel it towards great things.
“Harrower” is only the name given to this race in the common tongue, as the name in their own language of chitters and hisses cannot be easily translated. A single Harrower, as typically seen by other races, is actually a swarm of thousands of insects who have merged their intelligence to form a hive mind capable of highly sophisticated thought.
They are a squishy ranged character, and thus you will want to avoid putting yourself in a position to take hits. They specialize in reducing the effectiveness of enemies or putting debuffs on enemies that will make your allies’ attacks more effective through the use of Curse and Poison.
But be wary of allying with a Plagueherald, fellow adventurers, as their ability to spread decay and death across both sides of a battlefield is a terrifying thing to behold.

Let me keep you around a little longer as yet another mercenary has arrived in town.
Meet the (Angry Face) [spoiler] Doomstalker!
Though most Orchids live a life of meditation, there is a sect who believes that enlightenment should be achieved through hard work and not getting lost in thought for years on end. Because of its beliefs, the sect fled Orchid society across the Misty Sea to build farms and raise livestock in the wilds around Gloomhaven. The wilds are still dangerous, however, and the Orchid class of Doomstalkers is tasked with keeping these modest settlements safe. 
The calm mind of the Orchid makes the Doomstalker an excellent bow hunter. He never misses a shot. The Doomstalker is a medium-hp, giant hand-size ranged damage-dealer. And ranged damage-dealer he is, as he can inflict some really high damage from quite far away. His Doom mechanic also means that he has a unique rhythm to his playstyle that you will need to learn to master.

notes.content:
“Another street fight broke out... it was commonplace in the lower town. This time however, the crowd around the two concerned caught your attention. As you get closer, you manage to discern an imposing horned figure in the crowd, obviously settling her score with a thief who had the misfortune of trying to steal her purse full of gold. A new mercenary has arrived in town—and it seems that she was not alone. A figure covered in armor put an end to the combat, separated the attackers and settled the conflict in a few well thought words. Her large, mysterious eyes displayed considerable pride and disdain. Maybe a second recruit for your guild?”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png

TWO STRONG AND SOLID MERCENARIES ARE WAITING TO BE RECRUITED

Always eager to prove herself in a challenge, the first mercenary is a warrior willing to go to any lengths to keep her people safe, including sacrificing her own life. Careful, as the more wounded she becomes, the more dangerous it becomes to fight against her! Welcome the [spoiler]Berserker![/spoiler]

[spoiler]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/43674bf372ca8a723bd35cbc22cfb41f04bb5c95.jpg[/spoiler]

The second mercenary who joined the fight is from a unique race never seen in the Early Access… They often travel the world, seeking out situations where they can demonstrate their brilliant powers. [spoiler]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/72b5738eb0a12f48de0064d0c6ca2408dd52959c.jpg[/spoiler]

WELCOME TO TOWN: THE CITY STREETS AND ITS ENEMIES ARE NOW AVAILABLE!

Discover the all-new biome and venture out with your mercenaries along the city streets. From the merchant lane, to the upper town, pass through the shacks, walk the alleys with your mercenaries and enjoy the new features of this specific biome! 
 Rediscover the third AI adapted to the city streets: several criminals roam the city, and you can count on the guards to help you stop them. On the other hand, you too are a potential target for anyone with enough money to put on your head … 
 Begin a scenario with your mercenaries scattered around the map! Your team of mercenaries will start the scenario scattered alone or in pairs in different rooms. Time to adapt your strategies to regroup and to eliminate every enemy encountered.
With the brand new city biome comes fearsome new enemies! Do not be fooled by the presumed prosperity of the place: you are bound to attract unwanted attention during your journey in town… Keep an eye on them, and make sure to always stay on your guard, for many dangers are hiding behind the apparent calm of the streets: 

 City Archer
 City Guard
 Ancient artillery
 Harrower Infester
 A new boss: [spoiler]Merciless Overseer[/spoiler]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/ccb74dda0fddf81ade024561ba50935b94bab6b1.jpg

NEW QUESTS ADDED: A DARK CONSPIRACY IS BREWING IN TOWN... 

Restore peace and order through several new missions, guildmasters! 

 7 story missions: you will soon learn that a terrible plot is at work in the city. Whether it is for gold, fame or justice, you are the only one who can dismantle this organization and save an entire people.
 2 relic missions: powerful items could greatly help your Guild members during their missions…

You can now redo your last actions safely to recover from a grave mistake that might have been made in error and change the previously selected cards. 

REPORT YOUR BUGS DIRECTLY FROM THE GAME

You will also be welcomed by an all-new bug report option in game! From now on, when you will be encountering an error pop up, you will be able to report the issue directly from the game. The main advantage is that your save will automatically be sent to the developers, along with your report. This will greatly help us investigate the various bugs. Our community means a lot to us and we are very grateful for all the help we are receiving during this Early Access!

After whispering the last words and the last music chord, she held out her feathered hat towards you, obviously looking for some gold coins for the performance you just listened to …”

notes.content:
"How good it was to meet at your favorite table at the Sleeping Lion's Inn! Several mugs in hand, you manage to make your way through the mercenaries and locals who were feasting for whatever reason the beer gave them. Once you reached your table, you found your group of mercenaries counting the gold coins collected during your mission. An entire dungeon of bandits nullified—no survivors—and pockets full of gold coins, this is why you raise a glass tonight.”

SURROUND YOURSELF WITH ONLY THE STRONGEST OF MERCENARIES

The feature you've all been waiting for is now available on the open beta branch! Go for it now and join the open beta to test the online co-op mode!
The online co-op mode allows you to play online with your companions, train your group of mercenaries and set off against the hordes of enemies that inhabit the world of Gloomhaven. You will need to show strategy, cohesion and teamwork if you hope to triumph over your enemies.

As it is still in beta, prepare to face enemies of all kinds including … bugs! The goal of this open beta is to gather your feedback, your experiences and the potential bugs encountered in order to improve and refine, among other things, the stability of this new feature. 
If you encounter an issue and if you wish to help us resolve it, please make sure to contact us here: https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/gloomhaven/?contact=1 and provide as many details as you can gather (screenshots, recordings, quests, save file and logs). You can also join our official Discord here: https://discord.gg/4Nrk6zh

HOW TO JOIN THE OPEN BETA AND PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS?

To find the open beta version of the game:

 Right click on Gloomhaven in your Steam library
 Select properties
 Go to the betas tab
 Select the Open Beta branch included in that dropdown list
 Wait for your game to update

By default, this new build will create a separate, new save file.


To launch an online game: 

 Load a save game
 Click on “escape” and select “Multiplayer”
 You’re now the host of this game! 
 Share the code with your friends, or add your Steam friends to the party 
 Click on “Join the session” to enter the code and you will be added to the game

Please note that every party member can keep a save of the current game, and continue to play without the initial host. Also, any of your friends can join the game, at any time. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png

Have fun roaming the dark dungeons with your friends!

notes.title: Gloomhaven’s Early Access 1 year anniversary contest - Winner announcement!
notes.content:
“The world often turns on those with the best intents. Breaks us. I finally see my way of recognition. My first demonstration”.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png
Greeting mercenaries!

We received lot of submissions for our contest! It was a real pleasure for us to discover your creations and your terrifying bosses. We shuddered and were sometimes moved by your work, as did Isaac Childres. Here we are now at the end of this adventure, which celebrates the 1 year anniversary of Gloomhaven's Early Access.

5 BOSSES YOU DON’T WANT TO MESS WITH

First of all, congratulations to our 5 pre-selected entries! They win a free Gloomhaven’s Early Access Steam key! You convinced us with your work, and even though it was hard to decide, here are the dreadful bosses selected:

• Acadeus 
• Verik the Vile
• ILcriss living blight
• King Ooze
• Snowdrift

AND THE WINNER IS...

Among these five submissions, Isaac Childres had the delicate task of selecting only one, his favorite among the panel. Now is the time to reveal his number one creation... 

Congratulations to Vijay! He created a unique boss that was obsessed with recognition in the Eastern Continent as an inventor but received none. They call him Verik the Vile. The Sick, The Twisted. Atypical for a Quatryl.


He struck out alone, attempting a life in the Coin District of Gloomhaven. His gadgets were disregarded yet again by the locals, faulty or subpar. Shunned, he grew helpless. He worked, lacking sleep or sustenance. His plan was noble at first, to aid the guards with their woes of poisonous ailments; Vermlings and oozes amongst their misfortunes.

His goal was a prototype mechanical suit that matched his parameters for a demonstration. It was designed to vent away poisonous fumes through concealed compartments, protecting the wearer. Obsessed, Verik ignored his hunger and thirst for days. He grew emaciated, sickly. Desperate and reckless, he took sips of the thick sludge-like machine oil by his worktable. His thirst dissipated; his heart raced. He ravenously devoured the poisonous mushrooms gathered for his demonstration. Amidst the agony he felt, and the clawing he did to his face that night, he heard unseen whispers urging an idea. A change to his suit. An upgrade. In time, his first victim came knocking. 

Verik’s face was pale and bony, scratches along his cheeks and neck; both caked with dried blood. He wore a dense mechanical suit, looking half-built attached to a face mask. There were obvious pistons, rotating gears visible. It was a dull bronze, covering most of his upper arms and chest. The power core glowed an intense eerie green. His rust-coloured gloves and the three concealed cannisters along his back hissed, connected via numerous tubes. Two built-in whirring devices along his flanks allowed spurts of propulsion. His gangly frame and wasted body mattered little.  

“The world often turns on those with the best intents. Breaks us. I finally see my way of recognition. My first demonstration”, Verik remarked, holding out his glove. 

A cloud of noxious gas emanated from the tubes attached to the glove, draining one of the containers in his suit. Enveloped by the poisonous gas, the choking man crumpled. The body still twitched and writhed when Verik left the city unfettered. Verik was unseen but would be heard of again in time.


As a reward, he’ll receive in the weeks to come a copy of Gloomhaven, signed by Isaac Childres himself! 

We were delighted to organize such a contest and to have Isaac among the main jury in order to celebrate this anniversary with you all. We wanted to thank you for this year spent by our side. Whether you are there from the start, or whether you have joined us along the way ; whether you are introduced to the board game or an absolute beginner, your feedback and constructive criticism, as well as your daily involvement in this Early Access, have been of great help to us. Gloomhaven is a dense and complex game, and the team is thrilled to be able to work on such a project. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png
As always, stay tuned for more content to come!

IN THE GLOOM, YOU WILL FIND ONLY DEATH AND GREED...

notes.content:
“You arrive near the small village described by the innkeeper. As presented by the latter, the fields around the first houses were ravaged, the earth turned over and the plants uprooted. The work of the enemy tracked by your group of mercenaries, there is no doubt.
Once in the village, only the dull sound of the wind reached your ears. The shutters were closed, sometimes covered with wooden planks as temporary protection. After a few moments, you see a woman, with a child clutching at her apron, hiding behind her. 
She recognized your company and hastened to present you a huge bag of gold coins, if you could defeat the beast that has been terrorizing the area for several months now. She gave you a brief description of your prey, before showing you with a trembling hand a forest in the hills above the small farming village.
Whatever the origin of this enemy, you have never tracked one like it.”

His gaze then falls almost by reflex on the Mindthief behind you, the last mercenary to have joined your guild. Clearly, the Vermling made a culprit of choice in the theft of such an object. You quickly take the object from the merchant's hand and put it back in your satchel.

ENHANCE YOUR SUMMER WITH A 25% DISCOUNT

We hope this new content will delight you, as well as the neophytes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/364be21bb18884b2c2486c386190fbd60afa9b9f.jpg

Since the bandits and monsters made their way through the lands, people are afraid to leave their homes, making impossible trades and connections between towns. As a guild master, your mission will be to make the roads safer, not without filling your pockets in the process … Let’s see further what this journey has in store for you! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png
NEW TYPES OF QUESTS ARE WAITING FOR YOU!

Journey missions
These missions are taken to unlock new locations. Once your group of mercenaries is recruited, you’ll be able to explore the map and different towns and places thanks to the journey missions. The more you’ll explore, the more the map will be revealed to you. Liberating the region will also provide you with new missions to do and a handful of goods stocking your Merchant’s inventory! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/357249f3aad973704ddbeb3716fd2710f2b16bf3.jpg

Story missions
Once certain locations are unlocked, you’ll be able to try your luck in recruiting a mercenary! Each one of them will also bring a unique story line to the table. Learn more about their past and motivations thanks to these new immersive quests! 

Relic missions
These quests are unlocked by the Trainer and give you access to secret, powerful artefacts scattered throughout the lands of Gloomhaven. 

Job missions
As a guild master, your priority is to make gold, by exploiting the current context in which the region is struggling with. The Job quests are the recurring missions that will allow you to earn, among other things, money, experience and other generic rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png
MISSIONS OBJECTIVES AND DUNGEON MODIFIERS ARE HERE!

In addition to all this, each quest you carry out will be punctuated by very specific mission objectives, such as defeating a specific enemy, killing as many enemies as possible or protecting a character... Adapt your strategy and the management of your cards in order to fulfill the mission objectives! 
We are also adding modifiers! These will also deeply affect the way you play in a dungeon: a mission that appears to be a milk run would sound different if all your mercenaries started it wounded, right ?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bea8fd5a004e296df076a583f9a187f98f540e84.jpg

More missions are to come! As new content and new mercenaries are added, you’ll be able to discover their unique stories through dedicated quests! We will also bring new modifiers and objectives for the dungeons to get closer to the huge content of the board game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png
SAVE THE DATE: LIVE Q&A WITH FLAMING FOWL STUDIOS!

We are sure you still have plenty of questions about the upcoming Guildmaster update. Join us for a Q&A live session, on Discord, on June 24, 16:00 CET!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/7ff972d64fdf2e114b5bb98ab9e84dad3885317d.jpg

Here is the link to join our official Discord server. Ask your questions about the update in #qa_questions chat channel.
The Flaming Fowl Studios team, which develops the game, will answer as many questions as they can, in order to explain the new upcoming content to you in detail. Make sure to be there, mercenaries!

notes.title: Learn more about the new Guildmaster Mode and its systems!
notes.content:
“Once you’ve purchased a few potions and your equipment was ready, you faced your group. The Scoundrel finished sharpening her knives, while the Tinkerer tightened the last bolts of its latest wacky invention. Who knows what kind of damage that little thing could do thanks to the enchantress...
On the good advice of the trainer, you are about to go to the neighboring town to inquire about bandits who are demanding a tax from the surrounding farmers.
The merchant gave you a broad smile and wished you well, knowing full well that the sponsor had called in professionals. After a short visit to the temple, to ensure the good will of the gods, you head towards the exit of the capital, ready to start hunting…”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png
Greetings mercenaries! 

Following our last announcement about the upcoming Guildmaster mode, we wanted to share with you more details about it! As you may know, the current Adventure mode will be replaced by the Guildmaster mode on June 25, in which you’ll discover a more immersive and progressive gameplay. It is indeed a new way of looking at the game, while adding as you go along, essential bricks of content for us to build the final campaign.

[previewyoutube=veT3A_YjGII;full][/previewyoutube]

This time, we’ll talk about the Guild itself, and which improvements it brings. As the continent faces the arrival of bandits and monsters, the roads are not safe anymore. As a guildmaster, this is an opportunity for you and your mercenaries to make a few gold coins out of this mess.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png
UNLOCK YOUR FAVORITE MERCENARIES AND SWITCH ROSTERS

The first step will be unlocking your mercenaries scattered across the map. Here, you will have to recruit them yourself through dedicated missions! The game starts with Brute from the tutorial and you will then proceed to unlock the other five starting characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/b4c4d04deb02061c633d58a1125c964cf4dbb883.jpg

Once your team is assembled, the new Guild interface will allow you to change your roster. Between each dungeon and quest, you will be able to customize your company as you see fit and create your own hired blades raiding party. You are free to create parties of two, three or four mercenaries and change rosters between each dungeon! The choice is yours. Note that the enemy levels will still adapt according to the team you have chosen and the levels of the characters in it. Manage your roster and groups of mercenaries, from the most aggressive to the most cunning, by adapting your strategy to each new dungeon! Each character has its strengths and weaknesses, so make sure to balance your team before you embark on your adventure! 

Being able to switch your party members between scenarios is one of the several necessary steps for us to take on our way to the campaign from the board game. The long-term goal always remains a complete and faithful release of the original board game campaign. The Guildmaster mode and the board game campaign will be two seperate game modes, allowing you to experience two completely different adventures in Gloomhaven Digital.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png
BIND YOUR ITEMS

In the all-new Guildmaster mode, you’ll be able to bind items to a specific character. 
This prevents you from constantly switching the items between each of your characters, these guys are protective of their gear! Each item will be “bound” when equipped to a mercenary, which is another step towards the campaign mechanics. Please note that to retain flexibility in Guildmaster, you can unbind items for money.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png
WELCOME YOUR NEW ADVISERS!

Rest assured that you will not be alone as a guild master, you can count on your new advisers to support you in all the new tasks you will be responsible for, such as organizing your guild members and assigning them different perks and items.
4 new NPCs have been added in this new mode, allowing you to benefit from their advice throughout your adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/cbd20007ea10c1f30153a396671b92e539262d0d.jpg

The Trainer: You can count on the help of the Trainer during an entirely reworked tutorial. He’ll stay by your side during the game, sharing with you the best strategies and more! Moreover, he brings with him all the back end achievement systems, allowing you to unlock specific new missions and rewards by completing set requirements.

The Merchant: The merchant always has the business acumen! You’re always welcome in his shop. Furthermore, he has traveled a lot and surely knows his way around the region. Now, is he tagging along for money? Probably, yes.

The Enchantress: Inspired by your desire to rid the region of its ills, this mysterious woman will offer you her services by enhancing your abilities.

The Keeper of the Oak: She runs the Temple which allows you to be blessed in the next scenario. It is always good to be in the good grace of the gods… 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png
We are planning other more detailed posts on the new Guildmaster mode and its many improvements; stay tuned for it! We sincerely hope that these changes delight you! 
Don't forget: see you on June 25 for the arrival of the Guildmaster mode, the Gloomhaven adventure goes on!

notes.title: Become a Guildmaster
notes.content:
“After fighting the most ferocious monsters and the most cunning bandits, after traveling the plains of the continent, you thought you were at the end of your adventures ...

Pressed on the bar, sipping a well-deserved drink, fatigue could be read on your face. Then a hooded figure appeared next to you. Large horns protruded from his hood. With a quick wave of his hand, he ordered a full mug. Without saying a word, he slid a piece of parchment folded in half towards you on the counter.

Arching an eyebrow at the stranger, you grab the paper to discover its contents while the mysterious messenger finishes his glass suddenly and turns on his heels towards the exit.
Your eyes are returned to the parchment. A complete map of the lands of Gloomhaven, showing precisely the location of new equipment, formidable and powerful mercenaries to recruit and more ...

You thought you were at the end of your adventures ... So now discover the new Guildmaster mode!”


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png


Greeting mercenaries! 

As some of you have guessed, we have been working hard lately on a whole new way of adventuring throughout Gloomhaven. Since the release of the early access we have gathered very valuable feedback and requests from your reviews and comments. 

We are delighted to present to you, Gloomhaven Guildmaster: a new game mode coming in the Early Access. It is the largest update so far bringing highly requested changes and new content. Its objective is to both deliver the most gripping & enjoyable early access Gloomhaven experience AND to make a huge step in the direction of the board game campaign implementation. 

Here are few of many changes planned for the Guildmaster update coming on the 25th June:[olist] Manage freely your roster of mercenaries at any point of your adventure.
 Revamped the out-of-dungeon experience with new missions/objectives/stories. 
 Reworked the tutorial and introduction to gameplay mechanics.
 Cave biome and its monsters added.
 Co-op multiplayer in beta. [/olist]

[previewyoutube=veT3A_YjGII;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png

GATHER YOUR MERCENARIES AND BECOME A GUILDMASTER
As a Guildmaster, you will take control of a Guild of Mercenaries who see an opportunity to make a lot of money by reopening trade routes across the lands while everyone else is too afraid to do it. 
Thanks to the feedback given by our players, we understood that you wanted to be able to actively change your mercenary roster whenever you unlocked a new slot or when we added a new mercenary. 

In the Guildmaster game mode, you will be able to form your own company, modify freely your roster, and try out the best team synergies. 

We also understood that from your comments that the game was lacking objectives and goals as you play. In this update, you will take on over 90 challenging new missions to liberate areas of the map, uncover mercenaries’ stories, unlock powerful items, or simply earn extra gold coins as hired blades. New characters will follow the company in their journey and give out missions and rewards. 

Finally, we received reviews from new players regarding our learning curve and the gap between our tutorial and the in-game experience. 
This is why in the Guildmaster update also brings a reworked tutorial and a well-paced introduction so that newcomers and Gloomhaven experts alike will be able to discover and rediscover the core gameplay mechanics of Gloomhaven, as well as some of the advanced mechanics brought by each mercenary.

A lot of the hidden gameplay mechanics and programming code implemented in this upcoming update brings us closer to the full launch of the board game campaign that includes, but is not limited to:  Multiplayer co-op mode in beta
 Narration in and out of dungeons
 Possibility to change rosters
 Multiple new dungeon modifiers and objectives
 The addition of the Temple
 New monsters 

These are just a few examples of features and mechanics that are necessary to achieve one objective: deliver the greatest Gloomhaven digital adaptation with all the original board game content and campaign.


Please note that the guildmaster mode will replace the current adventure mode, therefore your progress will be lost. This is due to the way that the two modes work differently and how progress is measured, unfortunately progression cannot be translated between the two.


NEW BIOME: VENTURE OUT IN THE DARK CAVERNS… !

A brand new environment has been discovered! 

Prepare to discover the cave biome and its formidable enemies. If fighting a bear is part of your daily activities, beware of the imposing stone golem! Also try not to disturb the sleep of the drakes or vipers. That said, their scales must be worth their weight in gold…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/2d33950cfe11ae0ac6e7161c1527a2cb39edfaf8.jpg

CO-OP MULTIPLAYER: CLOSED BETA LAUNCH ON THE 25th JUNE!

Also we’re not forgetting the multiplayer co-op mode, which is on the top of our priority list. We know you’re very impatient to try it and so are we! 

We’re very pleased to announce that co-op multiplayer will be available in closed beta for a short period on the 25th and will later be released into open beta. 

We've taken the decision to launch it first in closed beta in order to make sure it is stable enough before officially creating a beta branch, where everyone will be able to give it a try. 
If you wish to join the multiplayer co-op closed-beta on the 25th June, you'll have to join our official Discord, where there will be a channel dedicated to this specific closed-beta. 

Click here to join the official Gloomhaven discord! 

Please note that these decisions are taken only to provide you with the best experience possible for this very awaited feature! 


WHAT’S NEXT?

This is the largest update so far in the early access bringing both new content and community requested changes and improvements. We’re getting closer to the campaign thanks to these reworks and massive changes. As some of you requested, we have updated the roadmap in order to give you an overview of future updates and content to come. The journey is still on! We still plan to launch the multiplayer mode in Q3, alongside The City update. So stay tuned for more details on that in the future!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/8761c8f1d16143194ff4e50ab78a3624165e5dca.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333530/bc2c3d7a3c7cb89554ba055f5bc1bbd87793e3eb.png

So what are your thoughts about the upcoming changes? We can't wait for you to try out all of these new exciting features! We will reveal more and explain further the new game mode to you in the days to come. Stay tuned for the upcoming posts! 


From Gloom, only greed and death emerge...

notes.title: Road Event Writing Contest - Winners announcement!
notes.content:
“A crowd was beginning to gather in front of the billboard of the Sleeping Lion Inn. Mercenaries, bards, and commoners clashed in the hope of distinguishing their written name from the precious piece of parchment placed against the panel. 

You could hear some people jostling, on the verge of drawing fists and swords. Others sighed loudly when they discovered that their text had not been retained. Eventually, you manage to get close enough to catch a glimpse of the names of the proud winners whose adventures would be told beyond the plains of Gloomhaven.”

Hello Mercenaries!

Our writing contest has come to an end! We’d like to thank everyone who tried their luck in this adventure. We loved reading your stories, from the most tragic to the most comical ones. Also, thank you to all the mercenaries who took time to read the entries and give their vote! Now is the time we reveal the winners… 

Congratulations to the following entries:
 A Downed Traveler

 Bloody Valrath

In order to better fit with the world of Gloomhaven and ensure game balance, we reserve the right to slightly modify and adapt certain passages and rewards so that they are in perfect harmony with other road events. Don’t worry! Any potential changes will be minimal, so as not to taint your work!
